name: elasticsearch
notes: daily rollover: the index name is <prefix>-<timestamp[:10]> derived per message from its payload timestamp; the second run's extra_field_values timestamp override lands every message in journalpump-2022-01-05
the mapping is derived from each index's FIRST message
the _bulk URL is the most recent index name (cosmetic); each action header carries the message's own _index
two senders WITHOUT a field filter share the handler's per-entry JSON cache, so the second sender's extra_field_values are ignored: the rollover runs are sequential, not concurrent
GET /_aliases polls are time-gated and excluded from the ordered comparison
batch/POST boundaries are timing-dependent: compare concatenated payload streams per index
